Q01.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id), ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-09-01'

Q02.sql: SELECT c.customer_level,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY 2 DESC

Q03.sql: SELECT region,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE paid_amount>0 AND order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY region

Q04.sql: SELECT strftime(order_date,'%Y-%m'),ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_history WHERE order_date>=DATE '2026-06-01' AND order_date<DATE '2026-08-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

Q05.sql: SELECT p.category,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY p.category

Q06.sql: SELECT c.customer_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND o.order_date<DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

Q19.sql: SELECT region,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM orders_current WHERE order_date>=DATE '2027-08-01' AND order_date<DATE '2027-09-01' GROUP BY region

Q07.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id),ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

Q08.sql: SELECT s.store_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id=s.store_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

Q09.sql: SELECT c.category_name,ROUND(SUM(i.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Q10.sql: SELECT c.channel_name,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o JOIN acquisition_channels c ON o.channel_id=c.channel_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 GROUP BY c.channel_name

Q11.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue),2),ROUND(SUM(ad_cost),2),ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue)/NULLIF(SUM(ad_cost),0),4) FROM ad_daily_stats WHERE stat_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND stat_date<DATE '2026-08-23'

Q12.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id),COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),0),4) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id=r.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

Q13.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(gmv) g FROM daily_store_metrics WHERE stat_date>=DATE '2026-08-01' AND stat_date<DATE '2026-08-23' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_name,ROUND(a.g,2),t.gmv_target,ROUND(a.g/NULLIF(t.gmv_target,0),4) FROM a JOIN sales_targets t ON a.store_id=t.store_id AND t.target_month='2026-08' JOIN stores s ON a.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY a.g DESC LIMIT 5

Q14.sql: SELECT o.order_status,COUNT(o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' GROUP BY o.order_status

Q15.sql: SELECT register_platform,COUNT(user_id) FROM users WHERE registered_at>=TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND registered_at<TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' GROUP BY register_platform

Q16.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0

Q17.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id),ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)

Q18.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id,o.paid_amount,c.category_name FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON p.category_id=c.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23' AND o.paid_amount>0) SELECT category_name,ROUND(SUM(paid_amount),2) FROM a GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
